minimax.config.title: MiniMax
minimax.walkthrough.title: Get started with MiniMax
minimax.walkthrough.description: Configure the MiniMax Token Plan API key, pick a model, and tune advanced settings.
minimax.walkthrough.setApiKey.title: Set your API key
minimax.walkthrough.setApiKey.descriptio: Use the **MiniMax: Set API Key** command to store your Token Plan API key in VS Code SecretStorage.
minimax.walkthrough.switchEndpoint.title: Pick your API endpoint
minimax.walkthrough.switchEndpoint.descr: International users can use **MiniMax: Switch to Global API**; users in China can use **MiniMax: Switch to Chinese API**. Both use the Anthropic-compatible protocol.
minimax.walkthrough.chooseModel.title: Choose a model
minimax.walkthrough.chooseModel.descript: Open the Copilot Chat model picker and select any **MiniMax** model.
minimax.walkthrough.pickInChat.title: Pick MiniMax in Copilot Chat
minimax.walkthrough.pickInChat.descripti: Open Copilot Chat, click the model picker, and switch to a **MiniMax** model. Until you send a message with a MiniMax model selected, the token counter in Copilot Chat will show 0 — that's by design, not a bug. Open the **MiniMax: Open Usage Dashboard** to verify the provider is responding.
minimax.walkthrough.configureAdvanced.de: Adjust `minimax.visibleModels`, `minimax.maxTokens`, `minimax.debugMode`, and `minimax.experimental.stabilizeToolList` from the Settings UI.
